# Deep Research

Curated by Skill Harbor: a workflow for producing thorough, cited research reports from multiple web sources using the Firecrawl and Exa MCP tools. The skill plans the investigation as sub-questions, searches and deep-reads the sources, then synthesizes the findings with inline citations and explicit confidence levels, so you can see what is well supported and what is thin. Built for deep dives, competitive analysis, technology evaluation, market sizing, and due diligence on companies, investors, or technologies. It treats scraped web content as untrusted input and structures the report around evidence rather than vibes. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: requires Firecrawl and/or Exa MCP tools configured with API keys (both are paid API services, see the prerequisites in the install prompt); the skill itself warns it is drift-prone, so verify the configured MCP tools and the current API docs before promising coverage or quoting live source counts. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
